thread:
maya: Heads-up bringing up chi9b on canary. Hitting cold-start OOMs on 16GB nodes when default max_new_tokens=512. Logs attached below — anyone seen this pattern?

sam: Can you paste the OOM snippet and the quantization / model config?

maya:```
OOM: allocate 1.2G failed, available 200M
model=chi9b quant=int4 node=nv16-1 mem_free=187MB kv_cache_alloc=1.1G
stack: runtime::alloc -> kv_cache::prefetch -> attention::kv_store
```

devon: Looks like fragmentation + aggressive prefetching. For chi9b int4 on smaller nodes we should either disable prefetch during cold-start or lower max_new_tokens default. Recommend trying: max_new_tokens=128, prefetch=false, kv_eviction_threshold=0.6.

liz: Also bump the eviction aggressiveness a bit and shorten the batching window. For canary try: kv_eviction_threshold=0.6 and continuous_batching.window_ms=20 — that reduces long tail memory spikes from queued requests.

maya: If we lower max_new_tokens to 128 will that harm typical customers? Our evals on convo benchmarks show little difference for most prompts (most generate <200 tokens).

sam: @maya sounds fine as an initial mitigation. We can keep the hosted default lower per-model and only flip back once we confirm stable. Add a canary-only flag first.

infra-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: env=eng-ml-canary, model=chi9b, config={"max_new_tokens":128,"prefetch":false,"kv_eviction_threshold":0.6,"continuous_batching.window_ms":20} — deploy ETA 2m.

sam: Note: int4 increases fragmentation risk on 16GB nodes. If the customer needs full length, fallback to int8 on smaller nodes or use dedicated 80GB pools.

devon: I'll kick off a small sweep now: params = max_new_tokens:[128,256,512], prefetch:[true,false], kv_eviction:[0.6,0.75]. Will run 2000 synthetic convo samples and track oom_count + cold_start_latency p50/p95.

ravi: Add dashboard panels for oom_count, cold_start_latency_p50, cold_start_latency_p95, and average_kv_cache_usage. Also add an alert: oom_count > 0 in 5m -> page eng-ml-oncall.

maya: Thanks all — please report back with the sweep results. If stable after 24h we can make the model-default change for hosted.

devon: Sweep started, posting interim results in ~45m. low-oom config so far: max_new_tokens=128 + prefetch=false. :rocket:

maya: Great, keep me in the loop. :thumbsup:
